title: The Bring a friend and Busy machines cards quietly vanish from Settings when the first check fails
what: When Settings opens, each card first asks the gym's server whether the feature is there. If that first ask fails (weak internet, a slow server), the failure is only written to the browser's hidden log and the card is simply not drawn. The owner sees no card, no error and no Try again, and can think the feature was taken away. It comes back only when Settings is opened again.
expected: A failed check shows the card with a short 'could not load, try again' line, or keeps the card and retries, instead of hiding the feature with no word.
how_often: each time the first check fails on opening Settings
fix_line: On a failed check, show the card with a small error line and a Try again button

title: Help questions and past imports show their dates by the computer's clock, not India time
what: The day shown next to each of 'Your questions' in Help and feedback, and the date and time of each past import, use the computer's own time zone. The rest of the admin app (the Visits register, receipts, Pay MettleUp) was changed to always use India time. On a computer set to another time zone, these two lists can show a different day or hour from everything else.
expected: These dates follow the same India-time rule as the rest of the admin app.
who: owners and desk staff on a computer set to another time zone
how_often: every time on such a computer
fix_line: Show these two dates with the shared India-time date rule

title: Every screen writes its own short-message timer, and they show for different lengths of time
what: The small 'Saved' style message is timed separately on each screen, in at least nine copies in this group alone, and they disagree: 2.6 seconds on Visits, Diet plans, Expenses and the member page, 3 seconds on Bring a friend, Busy machines and Gym timings, 3.5 seconds on Challenges and Entry machines. A change to how these messages behave has to be made in every copy.
expected: One shared message timer, with one length used across the screens.
fix_line: Move the message timer into one shared helper and use it on every screen
